function.name: generate_image_tool
function.description: Generates an image based on the provided description and saves it with the specified file name. The image description should be detailed to ensure the resulting image matches the desired subject and surroundings; otherwise, these aspects will be chosen randomly. This function is not intended for generating images from textual data. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

desc.description: A single string that provides a detailed description of the desired image. For example, 'a sunset over the mountains with a lake in the foreground'.

file_name.description: The name of the file to which the generated image will be saved. It should include the file extension, such as 'image.png'.

function.name: tts_tool
function.description: Converts the provided text content to speech and saves the resulting audio to a file. This function is intended for voice narration and should be used accordingly. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

content.description: The text content that needs to be converted to speech.

speaker.description: The voice to be used for the text-to-speech conversion.

file_name.description: The name of the file to save the audio output without the extension. If left empty, a default name will be generated based on the content.

function.name: write_markdown_tool

Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

content.description: The Markdown formatted text content to be written to the file.

filename.description: The name of the file to which the Markdown content will be written. If not provided, a default filename will be used.

function.name: write_html_tool

content.description: The HTML content to be written to the file. Must contain valid HTML structure.

filename.description: The name of the file to which the HTML content will be written. If not provided, a default filename will be used.

function.name: search_web_tool
function.description: Executes a search query using the DuckDuckGo search engine and returns a specified number of search results from a given source. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

query.description: The search term or phrase to be queried.

num_results.description: The maximum number of search results to return. A positive integer.

source.description: The source from which the search results should be fetched.

function.name: get_url_content
function.description: Scrapes the specified URL for textual data and returns the content as a string. This function is useful for extracting information from web pages when a URL is provided. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The web address of the page to scrape. It should be a valid URL format, such as 'http://www.example.com'.

timeout.description: The maximum time in seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up, with a default value that allows for a reasonable amount of time for most web pages to load.

user_agent.description: The User-Agent string to be used for the HTTP request to simulate a particular browser, which is optional. Some websites may require this for access.

message.content:
Here’s a quick‑reference list of the most common “tools” you’ll find when you’re looking to book flights—whether you’re a traveler, a developer building a travel app, or a travel‑agency operator.

| Category | Tool / Service | What it does | Typical use‑case |
|----------|----------------|--------------|------------------|
| **Online Travel Agencies (OTAs)** | **Expedia** | Full‑service booking (flights, hotels, car rentals) | End‑to‑end travel planning |
| | **Booking.com** | Primarily hotels, but also flights | Hotel‑centric itineraries |
| | **Priceline** | “Name Your Own Price” & “Express Deals” | Bargain hunting |
| | **Orbitz** | Similar to Expedia, often bundled with loyalty points | US‑centric travel |
| | **Hotwire** | Discounted “opaque” fares | Last‑minute deals |
| | **Travelocity** | Easy‑to‑use interface | General consumer booking |
| | **Kayak** | Aggregator that pulls from many OTAs | Price comparison |
| | **Google Flights** | Fast search, price alerts, route suggestions | Quick fare checks |
| | **Skyscanner** | Global search, flexible dates | International fare hunting |
| | **Momondo** | Similar to Skyscanner, often finds lower fares | Price comparison |
| | **CheapOair** | Focus on low‑cost carriers | Budget travelers |
| | **Opodo** | European OTA | EU‑centric travel |
| | **Trip.com** | Chinese OTA with global reach | Asia‑focused itineraries |
| | **Airbnb Experiences** | Not flights, but sometimes bundled with travel packages | Experiential travel |
| **Flight‑search APIs** | **Amadeus for Developers** | Flights, availability, pricing, seat maps | Enterprise & app dev |
| | **Sabre APIs** | Full GDS integration (booking, inventory, pricing) | Airline & agency back‑ends |
| | **Travelport APIs** | GDS‑style booking, inventory, pricing | Global distribution |
| | **Skyscanner Flights API** | Search, price alerts, flight details | App dev & price comparison |
| | **Google Flights API** (via Google Cloud) | Flight search, pricing, seat availability | Data‑driven travel tools |
| | **FlightAware API** | Real‑time flight status, tracking | Status monitoring |
| | **OpenSky API** | Real‑time flight data (free tier) | Aviation analytics |
| | **FlightStats API** | Flight status, delays, historical data | Operational analytics |
| | **IATA API** | Airport codes, airline codes, flight schedules | Data enrichment |
| **GDS (Global Distribution System) Interfaces** | **Amadeus GDS** | Direct airline inventory, booking | Large agencies |
| | **Sabre GDS** | Same as above | Large agencies |
| | **Travelport GDS** | Same as above | Large agencies |
| **Travel‑booking SDKs & Libraries** | **Python‑flight‑search** (open‑source) | Wrapper around Skyscanner/Amadeus | Quick prototyping |
| | **Node‑flight‑search** | Node.js wrapper | JS devs |
| | **Java‑flight‑search** | Java wrapper | Enterprise apps |
| **Automation & Scraping Tools** | **Selenium** | Browser automation for OTAs | Automated testing or scraping |
| | **Puppeteer** | Headless Chrome automation | Scraping or testing |
| | **BeautifulSoup + Requests** | Simple scraping of flight pages | Data extraction |
| | **Scrapy** | Full‑stack web crawler | Large‑scale data collection |
| **Travel‑management Platforms** | **Concur** | Corporate travel booking & expense | Business travel |
| | **SAP Ariba Travel** | Enterprise travel procurement | Corporate travel |
| | **Egencia** | Corporate travel management | Corporate travel |
| | **TravelPerk** | Modern corporate travel platform | Corporate travel |
| **Mobile Apps** | **Airbnb** | Flights + lodging | All‑in‑one |
| | **TripIt** | Itinerary organizer (can import flight bookings) | Post‑booking organization |
| | **Hopper** | Predictive pricing, alerts | Price prediction |
| | **Kiwi.com** | Multi‑carrier itineraries, “virtual interlining” | Complex itineraries |
| | **Rome2rio** | Multi‑modal travel planning | Planning entire trip |
| **Price‑alert & Deal Tools** | **Hopper** | Predictive pricing | Price alerts |
| | **Google Flights Alerts** | Email alerts | Price drops |
| | **Skyscanner Alerts** | Email alerts | Price drops |
| | **Kayak Alerts** | Email alerts | Price drops |
| | **Airfarewatchdog** | Alerts for specific routes | Deal hunting |
| **Travel‑booking Chatbots** | **Amadeus Chatbot** | Conversational flight booking | Voice & chat interfaces |
| | **Skyscanner Bot** | Conversational flight search | Voice & chat interfaces |
| | **Google Assistant** | Voice‑controlled flight search | Voice assistants |
| | **Amazon Alexa** | Voice‑controlled flight search | Voice assistants |

### How to choose the right tool

| Need | Recommended tool(s) |
|------|--------------------|
| **End‑to‑end consumer booking** | Expedia, Booking.com, Kayak, Google Flights |
| **Price comparison** | Skyscanner, Momondo, Kayak |
| **API integration for a travel app** | Amadeus, Sabre, Skyscanner Flights API |
| **Corporate travel management** | Concur, Egencia, TravelPerk |
| **Real‑time flight status** | FlightAware, FlightStats |
| **Data scraping / research** | Selenium, Puppeteer, BeautifulSoup |
| **Price alerts** | Hopper, Skyscanner Alerts, Google Flights Alerts |
| **Multi‑carrier itineraries** | Kiwi.com, Skyscanner |

Feel free to let me know if you need deeper details on any specific tool, how to integrate an API, or best practices for building a flight‑booking feature!
